children: MEXICO CITY, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Genomma Lab Internacional, S.A.B. de C.V. (BMV: LAB B) ("Genomma" or "the Company"), today announced its results for the third quarter 2026. All figures included herein are stated in nominal Mexican pesos and have been prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), unless otherwise noted.
Comments from Genomma's CEO, Marco Sparvieri

"Q3 2026 confirms that our recovery plan is working. Mexico improved for the third consecutive quarter and sell-out returned to growth, while market share held or grew across every business unit despite a soft market. Our late-June innovation is already driving +39% sell-out growth at clients carrying the new product, and Suerox reached a record 12.6% value share at our leading retailer.

Consolidated net sales grew +1.3%, with Latin America up +12.2%. We protected profitability with a 21.0% EBITDA margin while reducing SG&A, and net income rose +18.6% on lower financing costs and a favorable FX result, with free cash flow also improving versus last year.

We enter the fourth quarter with momentum, a stronger innovation pipeline and a solid balance sheet. On December 3rd in New York, we will present our new operating model, our execution commitments and our artificial intelligence platform in action, with measurable results and the ability to replicate winning playbooks across brands, functions and countries."

Genomma Lab Internacional, S.A.B. de C.V. is one of the leading pharmaceutical and personal care products companies in Mexico with an increasing international presence. Genomma Lab develops, sells and markets a broad range of premium branded products, many of which are leaders in the categories in which they compete in terms of sales and market share. Genomma Lab relies on the combination of a successful new product development process, a consumer-oriented marketing, a broad retail distribution network and a low-cost, highly flexible operating model. Genomma Lab's shares are listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange under the ticker "LAB B" (Bloomberg: LABB:MM).
